Cover Page Motion

Four moving pieces with their own sound, built for coverpageagency.com. Each one starts only when you scroll to it, pauses when it leaves the screen, and plays sound only after you tap the Sound button.

01 Spacetime tunnelOur wedding film, sliced through time
02 Spacetime echoEvery gesture leaves a trail
03 Event constellationHow a Cover Page wedding takes shape
04 InkA particle swarm that breathes with its sound
